data.narrative:
Vuecason operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at the Seed stage, having raised $3M+ to date. The broader sector comprises one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI, though no narrow peer set of sufficient size exists for direct median comparison.

Valuation analysis relies on Stage-Progression methodology, the sole applicable triangulation approach given peer set constraints. Using the $3M total raised as a base proxy and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields an implied valuation of $7.5M. This methodology is standard for early-stage companies lacking sufficient comparable transaction data.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M to $9M, with a median point of $8M. The $1.5M range reflects sensitivity around the stage-progression multiplier (2.5x carries inherent uncertainty at Seed stage) and the absence of transaction-level peer evidence. Material uncertainties include the precision of the total-raised proxy as a value anchor and whether sector-specific robotics dynamics warrant multiplier adjustment. A second-method validation through peer metrics would materially tighten this range, but current peer data does not support such triangulation.
